title: Enterprise AI Canvas: Integrating Artificial Intelligence into Business
extended_summary:
This paper proposes the Enterprise AI Canvas, a structured framework for planning and evaluating AI projects in business settings. The author argues that organizations often struggle to integrate AI because business value, operational decision-making, organizational change, and technical machine learning considerations are usually discussed separately. The paper’s central question is how to bring business experts, data scientists, and AI specialists together to define all relevant aspects of an AI use case before implementation.

The proposed canvas has two parts. Part 1 covers the business view: value creation, success metrics, decision and optimization processes, organizational impact, sponsorship, and relevant domains. Part 2 covers the model and data view: prediction and action, features, data sources and processing, domain expertise and data quality, constraints, and evaluation and monitoring. The framework is illustrated with a supermarket replenishment example, where AI predicts future demand and optimizes order quantities under practical constraints.

The paper is not an empirical study and does not involve a student, teacher, or school-based population. Instead, it is a conceptual/design contribution for adult professional users in business and data science roles. The main conclusion is that AI initiatives are more likely to succeed when business and technical considerations are integrated early through a shared planning artifact that supports cross-functional discussion and decision-making.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a conceptual/grey-literature style framework paper about an Enterprise AI Canvas for business use-cases, not an empirical study in K-12 education. It does not evaluate a K-12 intervention, use a comparison group, or report outcome data.
impact_tier_rationale: No student, teacher, or school outcome is measured, so there is no evidence of educational impact. The paper is not about science inquiry supports in K-12 and contains no impact findings relevant to the retrieved topic.
